# Support

Please report bugs and setup problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/M5LEE/wiresx-2-ysf-bridge/issues) so they can be tracked and help other users. Wherever possible, please avoid messaging M5LEE directly for support.

Read the README and troubleshooting guide, then search existing issues. Include version numbers, the exact step/error, what you expected and reproduction steps. For audio issues, include direction and UTC time. Redact screenshots and never post passwords, private connection profiles or location data.
